title: Charting the Uncharted: The (Un)Intended Consequences of Oil Sanctions and Dark Shipping
title_zh: 绘制未知领域：石油制裁与暗黑航运的（非）预期后果

title_secondary: Charting the Uncharted: The (Un)Intended Consequences of Oil Sanctions and Dark Shipping
authors: Jesús Fernández-Villaverde, Yiliang Li, Le Xu, Francesco Zanetti
official: 官方在线 2025-03-07 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We examine the rise of dark shipping -- oil tankers disabling AIS transceivers to evade detection -- amid Western sanctions on Iran, Syria, North Korea, Venezuela, and Russia. Using a machine learning-based ship clustering model, we track dark-shipped crude oil trade flows worldwide and detect unauthorized ship-to-ship transfers. From 2017 to 2023, dark ships transported an estimated 7.8 million metric tons of crude oil monthly -- 43\% of global seaborne crude exports -- with China absorbing 15\%. These sanctioned flows offset recorded declines in global oil exports but create distinct economic shifts. The U.S., a net oil exporter, faces lower oil prices but benefits from cheaper Chinese imports, driving deflationary growth. The EU, a net importer, contends with rising energy costs yet gains from Chinese demand, fueling inflationary expansion. China, leveraging discounted oil, boosts industrial output, propagating global economic shocks. Our findings expose dark shipping's central role in reshaping oil markets and macroeconomic dynamics.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了在西方对伊朗、叙利亚、朝鲜、委内瑞拉和俄罗斯实施制裁背景下，暗黑航运的兴起——即油轮关闭AIS收发器以规避监测。利用基于机器学习的船舶聚类模型，我们追踪了全球暗黑运输原油贸易流向，并检测未经授权的船对船转运。从2017年到2023年，暗黑船只每月运输约780万吨原油——占全球海运原油出口的43%——其中中国吸收了15%。这些受制裁的流动抵消了全球石油出口记录上的下降，但造成了显著的经济转变。美国作为净石油出口国，面临较低的油价，却从更便宜的中国进口中获益，推动通缩型增长。欧盟作为净进口国，需应对不断上升的能源成本，却从中国需求中获利，助长通胀型扩张。中国利用折价石油提升工业产出，向全球传播经济冲击。我们的发现揭示了暗黑航运在重塑石油市场和宏观经济动态中的核心作用。

abstract: This paper develops a procedure for uncovering the common cyclical factors that drive a mix of stationary and nonstationary variables. The method does not require knowing which variables are nonstationary or the nature of the nonstationarity. An application to the FRED-MD macroeconomic dataset demonstrates that the approach offers similar benefits to those of traditional principal component analysis with some added advantages.

title: Peer comparisons and the cost of pro-social behavior: Evidence from the lab
title_zh: 同伴比较与亲社会行为的成本：来自实验室的证据

authors: David Campoverde, Todd L. Cherry, David M. McEvoy, Tanga Mohr, Klaas van 't Veld
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-03 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Behavioral nudges in the form of peer-comparison information have, in many cases, proven effective in promoting pro-social behavior. The most prominent example is the use of home energy reports in electricity markets. While there is evidence that peer comparisons can induce reductions in externality-generating consumption, it is not clear through which channels the nudges operate. One possible channel is pecuniary: peer comparisons may make consumption choices more salient and prompt discovery of opportunities for financial savings. The other is non-pecuniary: peer comparisons may trigger moral motives such as guilt, social conformism, or social competitiveness. This study uses a controlled posted-price market experiment with externalities. We eliminate the “discovery” channel present in field settings by making financial incentives fixed and known. The experiment thus controls the pecuniary channel, leaving only the non-pecuniary, “moral” channel. We find that the nudge still enhances pro-social behavior, pointing to the moral channel’s importance. Two additional findings are that the nudge is equally effective across the treatments with low and high market prices (indicating that nudges and financial incentives neither complement nor crowd each other out) and that the nudge is more effective for participants with relatively cooperative worldviews.
abstract_zh: 以同伴比较信息为形式的行为助推，在许多情况下已被证明能有效促进亲社会行为。最显著的例子是电力市场中家庭能源报告的使用。尽管有证据表明同伴比较能诱导减少产生外部性的消费，但助推发挥作用的具体渠道尚不明确。一种可能的渠道是金钱性的：同伴比较可能使消费选择更加突出，并促使人们发现节省财务开支的机会。另一种是非金钱性的：同伴比较可能触发道德动机，如内疚感、社会从众心理或社会竞争意识。本研究采用带有外部性的受控标价市场实验。我们通过使财务激励固定且已知，消除了实地环境中存在的“发现”渠道。因此，该实验控制了金钱性渠道，仅保留非金钱性的“道德”渠道。我们发现，助推仍然增强了亲社会行为，这表明道德渠道的重要性。另外两项发现是：助推在低市场价格和高市场价格处理中效果相同（表明助推与财务激励既不相辅相成，也不相互排斥），且助推对世界观相对合作的参与者更为有效。

title_primary: 宏观审慎政策与资本流动

authors: Margaret Davenport, Filipa Sá, Tomasz Wieladek, Xuan Viet Ho, Brigitte Granville 等
official: 官方在线 2024-11-28 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper looks at how macroprudential policy can help reduce the risks associated with capital flows. We start by examining different types of macroprudential policy tools and their usage in different countries over time. We revisit the research on the link between capital inflows shocks and house prices and ask whether this link may have been weakened by the more extensive use of macroprudential instruments post global financial crisis. We review the empirical evidence on the effect of macroprudential policies on capital flows volatility and on the transmission of capital flows shocks to the real economy. We discuss the factors that may reduce the effectiveness of macroprudential policies in dealing with potential risks associated with capital flows, particularly leakages and spillovers. We conclude with open questions for policy and research.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了宏观审慎政策如何有助于降低与资本流动相关的风险。我们首先审视不同类型的宏观审慎政策工具及其在不同国家随时间的使用情况。我们重新审视了关于资本流入冲击与房价之间联系的研究，并探讨这一联系是否因全球金融危机后宏观审慎工具的广泛使用而有所减弱。我们回顾了宏观审慎政策对资本流动波动性及其对实体经济传导效应的实证证据。我们讨论了可能削弱宏观审慎政策应对资本流动潜在风险有效性的因素，尤其是漏洞和溢出效应。最后，我们提出了政策与研究领域待解决的问题。

title: Everyday Regular Prices in a Multi-Product Retailer

title_secondary: Everyday Regular Prices in a Multi-Product Retailer
authors: Nicoletta Berardi, Federico Ravenna, Mario Samano
official: 官方在线 2025-02-07 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Using a novel dataset from a large grocery retailer in a European country that never engages in temporary sale promotions, we establish that prices behave very similarly to regular prices set by retailers engaging in temporary promotional sales. We find evidence of state-dependent price setting in a multi-product firm when estimating the responsiveness of prices to exogenous demand shifts. The 'everyday regular prices' dataset is characterized by a more than trivial share of small price changes, and low synchronization of price changes across items. Price rigidity, selection and the extent of state-dependence are heterogeneous across items. Pricing of top sales items is more flexible and state-dependent compared to items that represent a small share of total revenues, a result consistent with price setting in a multi-product firm characterized by rational inattention. This result implies that inferences about firm-level price setting mechanisms from price microdata may be inaccurate if heterogeneity in price setting within the same firm is not taken into account.
abstract_zh: 利用来自欧洲某大型杂货零售商的新数据集（该零售商从不进行临时促销），我们发现其价格行为与那些进行临时促销活动的零售商所设定的常规价格非常相似。在估计价格对外生需求变动的响应性时，我们发现了多产品企业中状态依赖定价的证据。这一“日常常规价格”数据集的特点是，小幅价格变动占比显著，且不同商品间的价格变动同步性较低。价格刚性、选择效应及状态依赖程度在不同商品间存在异质性。畅销商品的价格相较于占总收入比重较小的商品更具灵活性和状态依赖性，这一结果与多产品企业中基于理性疏忽的定价机制相符。该结果表明，若忽视同一企业内部定价机制的异质性，基于价格微观数据对企业层面定价机制的推断可能不准确。

official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-24 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: As economic globalization and the specialization of labour deepen, competition among firms has increasingly shifted towards supply-chain-based competition. Accordingly, the continued enhancement of supply chain resilience has become a key issue in corporate strategic management. Using data on Chinese A-share listed firms from 2008 to 2024, this study examines the effect of shareholder chain relationship networks on corporate supply chain resilience and further explores the underlying mechanisms. The results indicate a significant positive association between shareholder chain relationship networks and corporate supply chain resilience, and the findings remain robust across a series of robustness checks. Mechanism tests demonstrate that operating risk diversification and resource allocation efficiency are important channels through which shareholder chain relationship networks enhance corporate supply chain resilience. Heterogeneity tests show that shareholder chain relationship networks have a more pronounced effect on enhancing supply chain resilience among firms with greater managerial myopia and higher internal control quality. abstract_zh: 随着经济全球化与劳动分工的深化，企业间的竞争日益转向供应链层面的竞争，持续增强供应链韧性由此成为企业战略管理的关键议题。本文利用2008—2024年中国A股上市公司数据，考察了股东链关系网络对企业供应链韧性的影响，并进一步探讨了其作用机制。研究结果表明，股东链关系网络与企业供应链韧性之间存在显著的正向关联，且该结论在一系列稳健性检验中依然成立。机制检验显示，经营风险分散与资源配置效率是股东链关系网络提升企业供应链韧性的重要渠道。异质性检验表明，在管理者短视程度较高及内部控制质量较高的企业中，股东链关系网络对供应链韧性的提升作用更为显著。关键词：股东链关系网络；企业供应链韧性；经营风险；资源配置 JEL分类：D22 G32 G41

abstract: We use career backgrounds of initial employees from a full cohort of U.S. startups to measure founding teams’ skillsets. Startups with more diverse prior industry experience grow faster than same-industry local peers. One-standard-deviation-higher diversity is associated with 16% (10%) higher five-year employment (sales) growth, controlling for demographic diversity, prestartup wages, and other observables. Startups in innovative industries and facing lower coordination costs among team members drive the results. To address endogeneity, we exploit shocks in which teams suddenly lose members with unduplicated skills. Overall, combining individual specialization with team-level diversification allows teams to act as “jacks of all trades and masters of each.” This paper was accepted by Bo Becker, finance. Sloan Foundation. Supplemental Material: The internet appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00773 .
abstract_zh: 我们利用美国初创企业完整队列中初始员工的职业背景来衡量创始团队的技能组合。拥有更多元化先前行业经验的初创企业，其增长速度超过同行业本地同行。在控制人口统计多样性、创业前工资及其他可观测因素后，多样性每增加一个标准差，五年期就业（销售）增长率分别提高16%（10%）。这一效应在创新行业及团队成员间协调成本较低的初创企业中更为显著。为解决内生性问题，我们利用团队突然失去拥有不可复制技能成员的冲击。总体而言，将个人专业化与团队层面多元化相结合，使团队能够成为“多面手且各有所长”。本文由金融学编辑Bo Becker接受。资助：本研究使用人口普查局纵向雇主-家庭动态项目的数据，该项目部分得到国家科学基金会[资助号SES-9978093、SES-0339191和ITR-0427889]、国家老龄化研究所[资助号AG018854]及阿尔弗雷德·P·斯隆基金会资助。补充材料：网络附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00773获取。

abstract: Lithium, cobalt, nickel, copper, and rare earth elements are reshaping global trade and great-power politics in ways reminiscent of the earlier scramble for natural resources. This column argues that the familiar resource-curse mechanisms still bite, but do so in a rather difference context characterised by a supply chain that is bifurcated between scattered extraction and Chinese-concentrated refining, global demand that is exposed to rapid within-class technological substitution, and the absence of a multilateral architecture comparable to the one that disciplined the oil age. This creates genuine Knightian uncertainty and emphasises the importance of smart contract design, appropriate fiscal policy – particularly on taxation – and the governance of supply chains.

abstract: Contrary to a long-standing concern, we present evidence that classical benefit-based labor income taxation in the tradition of Smith (1776) is consistent with income redistribution through transfers and negative average tax rates both theoretically and—in plausibly-specified simulations—quantitatively, at levels which reflect U.S. policy over the past several decades. title: Balancing Growth in a Warming World
title_zh: 变暖世界中的增长平衡
title_primary: 变暖世界中的增长平衡
title_secondary: Balancing Growth in a Warming World
authors: Adrien Bilal, Thibault Ingrand, Diego Känzig
official: 官方在线 2026-08-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper develops a theory of balanced growth and optimal climate policy in an integrated assessment framework. Balanced growth is possible despite climate change, but at a slower rate. Two distinct policy regimes emerge because emissions permanently raise carbon stocks. For low damages, optimal growth coincides with the laissez-faire and carbon is priced at a constant rate. For high damages, optimal policy caps temperature growth to prevent escalating losses and achieve faster economic growth than in the laissez-faire by pricing carbon at an increasing rate. We quantify our model and show that empirical damage estimates span both regimes. For low damages, optimal policy achieves a 1% welfare gain with 3 to 8°C of warming per century and no change in long-run growth. For high damages, optimal policy raises annual growth by 0.8 percentage points and achieves a 26% welfare gain by capping warming at 0.4°C per century.
abstract_zh: 本文在综合评估框架下构建了平衡增长与最优气候政策的理论。尽管存在气候变化，平衡增长仍可实现，但增速放缓。由于排放永久性提升碳存量，出现了两种截然不同的政策机制。在低损害情形下，最优增长与自由放任政策一致，碳定价保持恒定比率。在高损害情形下，最优政策限制温度增长以防止损失加剧，并通过递增的碳定价实现比自由放任更快的经济增长。我们对模型进行了量化分析，表明实证损害估计跨越了这两种机制。在低损害情形下，最优政策实现1%的福利增益，每世纪升温3至8摄氏度，且长期增长无变化。在高损害情形下，最优政策将年度增长率提高0.8个百分点，并通过将每世纪升温限制在0.4摄氏度，实现26%的福利增益。

abstract: we develop a framework for analyzing the determinants of economic development and their implications for policy. We distinguish between classical determinants—such as inputs into education and health, access to credit, and geography—and non-classical determinants—including cultural values, social norms, beliefs, identity, and social organization. We classify these determinants along two policy-relevant dimensions: whether they can be clearly ranked in terms of their contribution to development (vertical versus horizontal) and whether they can be directly altered through policy intervention (manipulable versus non-manipulable). We show that even for classical determinants, policy impacts are often hard to predict and are mediated by local social and cultural context. These issues are more pronounced for non-classical determinants, which are more complicated to change through policy intervention and more difficult to rank in welfare terms. In some cases, traits commonly viewed as obstacles to development may be well-adapted to local conditions or even supportive of economic performance, a possibility we refer to as “reverse vertical.” Building on Hirschman’s (1967) distinction between trait-making and trait-taking policymaking, we argue that interventions that attempt to directly transform non-classical determinants often rest on fragile assumptions about ranking and manipulability and risk generating unintended or adverse effects. By contrast, many of the most successful development episodes of the past several decades relied on policies that took existing social and cultural traits as given and designed institutions, technologies, and incentives that worked within those contexts rather than attempting to overturn them.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个分析经济发展决定因素及其政策含义的框架。我们将决定因素区分为经典决定因素——如教育卫生投入、信贷获取和地理条件——与非经典决定因素——包括文化价值观、社会规范、信念、身份认同和社会组织。我们沿着两个与政策相关的维度对这些决定因素进行分类：它们能否在发展贡献上被明确排序（纵向与横向），以及它们能否通过政策干预直接改变（可操控与不可操控）。我们表明，即便是经典决定因素，政策影响也往往难以预测，并受到当地社会文化背景的中介作用。这些问题在非经典决定因素中更为突出，因为它们通过政策干预加以改变更为复杂，且在福利意义上排序更为困难。在某些情况下，通常被视为发展障碍的特质可能适应当地条件，甚至有助于经济表现，我们将这种可能性称为“反向纵向”。基于赫希曼（1967）关于特质创造与特质利用政策制定的区分，我们认为，试图直接转变非经典决定因素的干预措施往往依赖于关于排序和可操控性的脆弱假设，并可能引发意外或不利后果。相比之下，过去几十年许多最成功的发展案例依赖于将现有社会文化特质视为既定条件，并设计在这些情境内运作的制度、技术和激励机制，而非试图颠覆它们。

abstract: We estimate that nominal AI compute spending grew over 140 percent per year each in 2024 and 2025, raw compute capacity grew over 200 percent per year, and quality-adjusted AI output grew over 2,000 percent per year. These growth rates reflect three compounding forces: expanding data-center capacity, continued improvements in chip efficiency, and rapid algorithmic progress. We then employ our estimates to develop a nascent framework for “AI GDP” that tracks the AI economy as a coherent whole rather than dispersed across standard industry classifications. Quality-adjusted AI GDP grew by more than 2,500 percent each in 2024 and 2025. Our measures complement traditional national accounts by providing visibility into a fast-moving sector whose activity is difficult to isolate in existing statistics, and they may serve as building blocks for satellite accounts that track AI’s growing role in the economy.
abstract_zh: 我们估算，2024年和2025年名义人工智能计算支出每年增长超过140%，原始计算能力每年增长超过200%，质量调整后的人工智能产出每年增长超过2000%。这些增长率反映了三种叠加力量：数据中心容量的扩张、芯片效率的持续提升以及算法领域的快速进步。随后，我们利用这些估算构建了一个初步的"人工智能GDP"分析框架，将人工智能经济作为一个有机整体进行追踪，而非分散在标准行业分类中。2024年和2025年，质量调整后的人工智能GDP每年增长超过2500%。我们的测算方法补充了传统国民账户体系，为这一快速发展的行业提供了可见性——其经济活动在现有统计中难以单独识别，同时可作为构建卫星账户的基础模块，用于追踪人工智能在经济中日益增长的作用。

abstract: We document arguably unintended returns of biodiversity conservation to science discovery, exploiting the 2002 fishing ban in China—an ecosystem restoration policy without explicit science-related objectives, which allows us to implement a difference-in-differences design across fish species. We find that the ban substantially increased research on affected species: funded programs rose by 21.5%, total funding by 22.8%, publications per program by 97.0%, and citations per paper by 106.7%. The effect is concentrated among researchers with geographic access to the river, and is stronger for non-extinct species and non-farmed fish species, suggesting that conservation expanded the supply of biological materials available for research. The ban also increased related public influence and patents. These results reveal that biodiversity conservation generates a significant scientific dividend through the restoration of natural research inputs, with implications for evaluating the broader benefits of ecosystem protections in an underdiscussed dimension for the science of science.
abstract_zh: 我们记录了生物多样性保护对科学发现的意外回报，利用2002年中国实施的禁渔令——一项没有明确科学相关目标的生态系统恢复政策，这使得我们能够对鱼类物种进行双重差分设计。研究发现，禁渔令显著增加了受影响物种的研究：资助项目数量上升21.5%，总资助金额增加22.8%，每个项目的论文产出提高97.0%，每篇论文的引用量增长106.7%。这一效应集中在具有河流地理接近性的研究人员中，且对非灭绝物种和非养殖鱼类更为显著，表明保护措施扩大了可供研究的生物材料供给。禁渔令还提升了相关的公众影响力及专利数量。这些结果揭示，生物多样性保护通过恢复自然研究投入产生了显著的科学红利，对在科学学中尚未充分讨论的维度上评估生态系统保护的更广泛效益具有启示意义。

abstract: Using the agent‐based model SWISSland, we simulate farm‐level responses and interactions under two institutional shocks: tariff reductions and direct payment reductions. Using a framework we developed, we assess resilience capacities, resilience attributes, and the provision of private and public goods, following the shock. Results indicate that valley farms are vulnerable to tariff reductions and mountain farms to direct payment reductions. Payment cuts cause minor changes in private and public goods provision, while tariff reductions reduce provision levels. It shows that different shocks require different resilience attributes, underscoring the need for ex‐ante resilience assessments to develop targeted measures strengthening farm resilience.
abstract_zh: 基于主体模型SWISSland，我们模拟了两种制度冲击下的农场层面响应与互动：关税削减与直接支付削减。运用我们开发的框架，评估冲击后的韧性能力、韧性属性以及私人与公共产品的供给。结果表明，山谷农场易受关税削减影响，而山地农场则对直接支付削减更为敏感。支付削减对私人与公共产品供给的影响较小，而关税削减则降低了供给水平。这表明不同冲击需要不同的韧性属性，凸显了开展事前韧性评估以制定针对性措施、增强农场韧性的必要性。

title: A Regressive Shock? The Distributional Consequences of Middle East Conflict-Driven Inflation for German Households
title_zh: 倒退式冲击？中东冲突驱动型通胀对德国家庭的分配效应

authors: Michael Christl & Andreas Peichl & Tiphaine Wibault
official: 官方在线 2026-01-01 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The escalation of the conflict in the Middle East in late February 2026 led to a sharp upward revision in inflation forecasts for Germany, which we attribute primarily to the conflict itself. Using microsimulation methods adapted to simulate a commodity price change, we translate this forecast revision into upper bounds on household-specific purchasing-power losses via a compensating variation approach, distinguishing the loss recovered through consumption taxes from the full loss including the pre-tax transfer to producers. Both measures are sizeable and regressive: in 2026, the average household loses 0.25% of income through the tax channel and 1.15% under the full measure, with bottom-decile losses of 0.63% and 2.87% against 0.12% and 0.65% for the top decile. The Gini coefficient rises by up to 0.14 points, and elderly households are disproportionately affected. Our results show that a supply-side shock originating outside Europe can have a sizeable and unequal impact on household living standards.
abstract_zh: 2026年2月底中东冲突升级导致德国通胀预期大幅上调，我们将其主要归因于冲突本身。通过采用适用于模拟大宗商品价格变化的微观模拟方法，我们利用补偿变差法将这一预测修正转化为家庭购买力损失的上限估计，区分了通过消费税回收的损失与包含税前生产者转移的完整损失。两种测算结果均规模显著且呈累退性：2026年，普通家庭通过税收渠道损失0.25%的收入，完整测算下损失1.15%，其中收入最低十分位家庭的损失分别为0.63%和2.87%，而最高十分位家庭仅为0.12%和0.65%。基尼系数上升幅度达0.14个百分点，老年家庭受到不成比例的影响。研究结果表明，源自欧洲外部的供给侧冲击可能对家庭生活水平产生显著且不均等的影响。

abstract: This paper studies how collective bargaining affects wages and amenities. By merging collective bargaining agreements (CBAs) to linked employer-employee data in Brazil, I combine rich contracted amenities with wage information. I implement a difference-in-difference strategy that exploits a court ruling enforcing CBA continuation (i.e., ultractivity) to estimate the effects of union bargaining power. Strengthening unions raises wages and amenities without reducing employment—increasing retention despite some labor-labor substitution. A revealed preference approach shows that amenities account for 45% of total compensation gains. These findings suggest that collective bargaining can offset monopsony power, but employers retain the right-tomanage workforce composition.
abstract_zh: 本文研究集体谈判如何影响工资与福利。通过将集体谈判协议与巴西雇主-雇员关联数据匹配，我整合了丰富的合同约定福利与工资信息。采用双重差分策略，利用法院关于强制延续集体谈判协议（即超期效力）的裁决，估计工会谈判力量的影响。强化工会力量在未减少就业的情况下提高了工资与福利——尽管存在部分劳动力替代效应，但员工留存率有所提升。基于显示性偏好方法的研究表明，福利占薪酬总增长的45%。这些发现表明，集体谈判可抵消买方垄断势力，但雇主仍保留管理劳动力构成的权利。

abstract: Capital resale frictions, by increasing liquidity risk and decreasing collateral values, can depress investment and amplify capital misallocation in the entrepreneur sector. I provide qualitative evidence using investment data from startups, and quantify these channels using a calibrated entrepreneurial choice model with production risk, financial frictions, and capital resale frictions. I decompose the effects coming from production risk, financial frictions, and resale frictions. I find that resale frictions increase average excess returns by 2.13 pp, and reduce aggregate productivity by 12.7%. The impact of resale frictions are substantially larger than financial frictions or production risk.
abstract_zh: 资本转售摩擦通过增加流动性风险和降低抵押品价值，可能抑制企业家部门的投资并加剧资本错配。本文利用初创企业的投资数据提供了定性证据，并通过一个包含生产风险、金融摩擦和资本转售摩擦的校准化企业家选择模型对这些渠道进行了量化分析。我将生产风险、金融摩擦和转售摩擦的影响进行了分解。研究发现，转售摩擦使平均超额回报率提高2.13个百分点，并使全要素生产率降低12.7%。转售摩擦的影响显著大于金融摩擦或生产风险。

title: Inverse Selection
title_zh: 逆向选择
title_primary: 逆向选择

authors: Brunnermeier, Markus K., Lamba, Rohit, Segura-Rodriguez, Carlos
official: 来源期次 American Economic Review: Insights · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: Big data and AI invert classical adverse selection: insurers can now infer statistical correlations that consumers cannot, overturning the traditional informational advantage. We study insurance contracting where a two-dimensional state determines risk, the agent privately knows one dimension, and the insurer privately knows how the two correlate. The insurer faces a trade-off between obfuscation and price discrimination: Fine-tuned contracts enable better screening but may reveal her statistical advantage. The optimal policy exhibits a bang-bang structure: pooling on a statistical model that renders the agent’s information worthless, and full disclosure elsewhere. Profits increase substantially when agents fail to perform Bayesian inference.
abstract_zh: 大数据与人工智能颠覆了经典逆向选择：保险公司如今能够推断出消费者无法获知的统计相关性，从而扭转了传统的信息优势。本文研究了一种保险契约模型，其中风险由二维状态决定，代理人私下知晓其中一个维度，而保险人私下知晓这两个维度之间的相关性。保险人面临模糊化与价格歧视之间的权衡：精细调整的契约有助于更好地筛选，但可能暴露其统计优势。最优策略呈现“砰-砰”结构：在使代理人信息失效的统计模型上实行混同，而在其他情况下实行完全披露。当代理人未能进行贝叶斯推断时，利润显著增加。

abstract: Standard procurement models assume that the buyer knows the quality of the good at the time of procurement; however, in many settings, the quality is learned only long after the transaction. We study procurement problems in which the buyer’s valuation of the supplied good depends directly on its quality, which is unverifiable and unobservable to the buyer. For a broad class of procurement problems, we identify procurement mechanisms maximizing any weighted average of the buyer’s expected payoff and social surplus. The optimal mechanism can be implemented via an auction that restricts sellers to submitting bids within specific intervals.

title: The Perils of Overreaction
title_zh: 过度反应的风险
title_primary: 过度反应的风险
title_secondary: The Perils of Overreaction
authors: von Beringe, Konstantin, Whitmeyer, Mark
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: In order to study updating rules, we consider the problem of a malevolent principal screening an imperfectly Bayesian agent. We uncover a fundamental dichotomy between underreaction and overreaction to information. If, for some signal realization, the agent’s updating rule produces a posterior that lies outside the convex hull of the Bayesian posteriors induced by the signal structure, then she can be exploited by the principal without bound: her ex ante expected loss can be made arbitrarily large. In contrast, an agent who underreacts–whose posterior after each signal realization lies between the prior and the corresponding Bayesian posterior–cannot be exploited at all.
abstract_zh: 为研究更新规则，我们考察了恶意委托人筛选非完全贝叶斯代理人的问题。研究发现信息反应不足与反应过度之间存在根本性二分：若对于某些信号实现值，代理人的更新规则产生的后验概率落在信号结构所诱导的贝叶斯后验概率凸包之外，则委托人可无上限地利用该代理人——其事前预期损失可被任意放大。反之，采取反应不足策略的代理人（其各信号实现值对应的后验概率始终介于先验概率与相应贝叶斯后验概率之间）则完全不会被利用。

title: Gender and Adoption of Climate‐Smart Agricultural Practices in Developing Countries: Evidence From West African Countries

title_primary: 发展中国家性别与气候智慧型农业实践采纳：来自西非国家的证据

authors: Abraham Amoussouga Gero, Aklesso Y. G. Egbendewe
source: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
official: 官方在线 2026-07-06 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper examines the influence of gender on the adoption of Climate‐Smart Agriculture (CSA) practices in West Africa. An exogenous switching treatment effect regression model with the Oaxaca–Blinder decomposition method is used in the study. Data were collected from the 2018/2019 Harmonized Household Living Conditions Survey across five West African countries. The results indicate that if female plot managers had the same characteristics as their male counterparts, their likelihood of adopting CSA practices would increase, yet it would still be lower than that of men. The decomposition analysis shows a significant gender gap favouring men in Burkina Faso and Senegal, unlike in Ivory Coast and Togo. These gender differences are mainly due to structural factors such as household size, education, access to credit, commercialisation, income, livestock ownership, family labour, pesticide use, soil fertility and the availability of agricultural extension agents and cooperatives. To effectively address gender disparities in CSA adoption, policies could focus on improving these structural conditions rather than solely on ensuring equal access to production resources. This approach would enhance policy effectiveness and empower women to better utilise their agricultural resources.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了性别对西非气候智慧型农业（CSA）实践采纳的影响。研究采用外生转换处理效应回归模型与奥克萨卡-布林德分解方法，数据来源于2018/2019年五个西非国家的统一家庭生活条件调查。结果表明，若女性地块管理者具备与男性相同的特征，其采纳CSA实践的可能性将有所提升，但仍低于男性。分解分析显示，布基纳法索和塞内加尔存在显著偏向男性的性别差距，而科特迪瓦和多哥则未出现此类差异。这些性别差异主要源于结构性因素，包括家庭规模、教育水平、信贷获取、商业化程度、收入、牲畜所有权、家庭劳动力、农药使用、土壤肥力以及农业推广人员和合作社的可及性。为有效解决CSA采纳中的性别差异，政策应侧重于改善这些结构性条件，而非仅关注生产资源的平等获取。这一方法将提升政策有效性，并增强女性利用农业资源的能力。

title: Literacy, numeracy skills and free basic education in Ghana
title_zh: 加纳的识字、算术技能与免费基础教育

authors: Egyir, John
official: 官方在线 2026-06-29 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Literacy and numeracy unarguably are at the heart of human and economic development and, as a result, have received widespread attention in recent decades. Yet, there are still issues related to the effective strategies of creating such basic skills. In this paper, I show how a free compulsory universal basic education (FCUBE) policy in Ghana helped improve skills attainment. I employ a difference-in-differences strategy to assess the long-term causal impact of FCUBE using the Ghana Living Standard Survey 2012-2017. Overall, I find that FCUBE increased literacy and numeracy by 4.6 and 3.0 p.p respectively, but had a larger effect for urban and less disadvantaged students, thereby exacerbating inequality in skills attainment. Additionally, my results show that only the lower secondary education, and not primary education, was sufficient to guarantee skills attainment.
abstract_zh: 毋庸置疑，识字与算术能力是人类与经济发展的核心，因此近几十年来受到广泛关注。然而，如何有效培养这些基本技能仍存在诸多问题。本文展示了加纳免费义务普及基础教育政策如何促进技能提升。我采用双重差分法，利用2012-2017年加纳生活水平调查数据，评估该政策的长期因果效应。总体而言，研究发现该政策使识字率与算术能力分别提升4.6和3.0个百分点，但对城市及弱势程度较低的学生影响更大，从而加剧了技能获取的不平等。此外，研究结果表明，仅初中教育而非小学教育足以保障技能习得。

title: Does the Import Invasion Explain the Mysterious Disappearance of Productivity Growth in U.S. Manufacturing?
title_zh: 进口入侵是否解释了美国制造业生产率增长的神秘消失？
title_primary: 进口入侵是否解释了美国制造业生产率增长的神秘消失？
title_secondary: Does the Import Invasion Explain the Mysterious Disappearance of Productivity Growth in U.S. Manufacturing?
authors: Robert J. Gordon, Kenneth Ryu
official: 官方在线 2026-06-21 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Why did U.S. manufacturing productivity stop growing after 2010? Productivity growth disappeared, evaporating from an annual rate of +3.3 percent during 1987-2010 to -0.3 percent from 2010 to 2023. This paper shifts attention from 2010 as the start of the puzzle to a decade earlier when output stopped growing. This cessation of output growth in 2000 is attributed to the invasion of imports that closed domestic plants, destroyed jobs, and squeezed profits. Then followed a chain of causation that ultimately undermined productivity growth – from falling capacity utilization, to lower investment in fixed capital and R&D, and to an erosion of innovation. Beyond the import invasion, the paper identifies a set of handicaps ranging from self-inflicted wounds to short-sighted government policy. Corporate funds were diverted from productive investment to share buybacks. Investment was distorted by environmental, health, safety, and fuel economy regulations. Other issues with government policy include a substantial reduction in public R&D and a failure to develop training programs to alleviate a decades-long shortage of skilled labor.
abstract_zh: 为何2010年后美国制造业生产率增长停滞？生产率增长消失殆尽，从1987-2010年间年均3.3%的增速骤降至2010-2023年间的-0.3%。本文将研究焦点从2010年这一谜题起点前移至产出停止增长的十年前。2000年产出增长停滞归因于进口冲击——进口产品涌入导致国内工厂关闭、就业岗位消失、利润空间被挤压。由此引发连锁因果链，最终侵蚀生产率增长：从产能利用率下降，到固定资本与研发投资减少，再到创新能力削弱。除进口冲击外，本文还识别出一系列制约因素，涵盖企业自损行为与短视政府政策：企业资金从生产性投资转向股票回购；环境、健康、安全及燃油经济性法规扭曲投资结构；政府政策问题包括公共研发投入大幅削减，以及未能制定培训计划以缓解持续数十年的技能劳动力短缺。

title: Data factor marketization and corporate investment efficiency—A Quasi-Natural Experiment based on the establishment of data trading platforms
title_zh: 数据要素市场化与企业投资效率——基于数据交易平台设立的准自然实验
title_primary: 数据要素市场化与企业投资效率——基于数据交易平台设立的准自然实验
title_secondary: Data factor marketization and corporate investment efficiency—A Quasi-Natural Experiment based on the establishment of data trading platforms
authors: Yuanbin Xu, Xinyang Zhang, Shiyun Zhong, Yani Wang, Fucai Lu
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-06 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: As the core engine of the new round of technological revolution, the digital economy has made data factors a key driver of high-quality corporate development. This paper takes the establishment of data trading platforms as a quasi-natural experiment, uses data from A-share listed companies in Shanghai and Shenzhen from 2012 to 2022, and adopts a multi-period difference-in-differences (DID) model to examine the impact of data trading platform establishment on corporate investment efficiency and its internal mechanism. The research results show that the establishment of data trading platforms significantly reduces corporate investment inefficiency. Mechanism analysis indicates that data factor marketization mitigates corporate investment inefficiency by reducing information asymmetry, optimizing resource allocation efficiency, and promoting corporate digital technology innovation. Heterogeneity tests reveal that the above positive effects are more significant in mature and declining enterprises as well as non-state-owned enterprises, and mainly reduce investment inefficiency by curbing over-investment. From the perspective of investment efficiency, this paper reveals the positive impact of data factor marketization at the micro-enterprise level, providing empirical evidence for improving the construction of data factor marketization.
abstract_zh: 作为新一轮科技革命的核心引擎，数字经济使数据要素成为企业高质量发展的关键驱动力。本文以数据交易平台的设立作为准自然实验，利用2012—2022年沪深A股上市公司数据，采用多期双重差分（DID）模型，考察数据交易平台设立对企业投资效率的影响及其内在机制。研究结果表明，数据交易平台的设立显著降低了企业投资无效率。机制分析显示，数据要素市场化通过降低信息不对称、优化资源配置效率以及促进企业数字技术创新，进而缓解企业投资无效率。异质性检验发现，上述积极效应在成熟期和衰退期企业以及非国有企业中更为显著，且主要通过抑制过度投资来降低投资无效率。本文从投资效率视角揭示了数据要素市场化在企业微观层面的积极影响，为完善数据要素市场化建设提供了经验证据。

title: Geographic mortality differentials and the quality-quantity trade-off
title_zh: 地理死亡率差异与质量-数量权衡
title_primary: 地理死亡率差异与质量-数量权衡
title_secondary: Geographic mortality differentials and the quality-quantity trade-off
authors: Sinara Gharibyan, David Gomtsyan, Èric Roca Fernández
official: 官方在线 2026-05-29 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper explores the relationship between geographic mortality differentials and human capital investment patterns in the Malthusian setup of 19th-century Armenia. We examine how variations in altitude are associated with mortality rates, human capital accumulation, and fertility decisions. Using detailed historical census and parish records, we document that higher-altitude areas tend to have lower population density, lower respiratory disease mortality, and lower overall mortality. Our empirical analysis also shows that individuals in these environments tend to display better numeracy skills and lower fertility rates. These findings align with the Ben-Porath hypothesis, suggesting that longer life horizons encourage shifting from child quantity to quality. Furthermore, these patterns are not driven by income differences or increased female autonomy arising from pastoral agriculture.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了19世纪亚美尼亚马尔萨斯式环境下，地理死亡率差异与人力资本投资模式之间的关系。我们研究了海拔变化如何与死亡率、人力资本积累及生育决策相关联。利用详细的历史人口普查和教区记录，我们发现高海拔地区往往具有较低的人口密度、较低的呼吸系统疾病死亡率以及较低的总体死亡率。实证分析还表明，这些环境中的个体通常表现出更好的计算能力和较低的生育率。这些发现与Ben-Porath假说一致，表明更长的生命预期鼓励从子女数量向质量的转变。此外，这些模式并非由收入差异或牧业农业带来的女性自主权增强所驱动。

title: Measurement Error and Counterfactuals in Quantitative Trade and Spatial Models
title_zh: 定量贸易与空间模型中的测量误差与反事实分析

authors: Bas Sanders

abstract: Counterfactuals in quantitative trade and spatial models are functions of the current state of the world and the model parameters. Common practice treats the current state of the world as perfectly observed, but there is good reason to believe that it is measured with error. This paper provides tools for quantifying uncertainty about counterfactuals when the current state of the world is measured with error. I recommend an empirical Bayes approach to uncertainty quantification, and show that it is both practical and theoretically justified.
abstract_zh: 定量贸易与空间模型中的反事实分析依赖于当前世界状态与模型参数。现有研究通常将当前世界状态视为完全可观测的，但实际测量中很可能存在误差。本文提供了当当前世界状态存在测量误差时，量化反事实分析不确定性的工具。我推荐采用经验贝叶斯方法进行不确定性量化，并证明该方法兼具实用性与理论合理性。

title: The VCG mechanism, the core, and assignment stages in auctions
title_zh: VCG机制、核心与拍卖中的分配阶段
title_primary: VCG机制、核心与拍卖中的分配阶段
title_secondary: The VCG mechanism, the core, and assignment stages in auctions
authors: Lawrence M. Ausubel, Oleg Baranov
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-09 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The Vickrey-Clarke-Groves (VCG) mechanism is one of the most compelling constructs in mechanism design, but the presence of complementary goods creates the possibility of non-core and even zero-revenue outcomes. In this article, we show that joint feasibility constraints on allocations offer a second pathway to ill-behaved outcomes in the VCG mechanism, even when all bidders have substitutes preferences for the goods. We then develop a theory of complementarities specifically tailored to assignment stages of spectrum auctions. Assignment stages typically guarantee contiguous spectrum to each winner—this proves to be an especially severe joint feasibility constraint. We propose a definition of bidder complementarities and further dichotomize them as direct or indirect. When opponents bid on distinct parts of a bidder’s preferred assignment, they set up a direct bidder complementarity. However, if an assignment is denied through the contiguity restriction, that is called an indirect complementarity. As a result, non-core outcomes, together with all of the accompanying anomalies, can be expected in VCG assignment stages. We then examine a conspicuous recent spectrum auction, the FCC’s Broadcast Incentive Auction, and we provide the first documentation of zero-revenue outcomes in the field. Of 207 assignment stage auctions with at least three bidders, 17.9% produced non-core outcomes relative to the bids and, of these, 3 generated zero revenues. After rescaling bidder values, we find that the majority of assignment stage auctions had the potential for exploitable bidder complementarities and that the vast majority of bidder complementarities—both potential and realized—were indirect.
abstract_zh: 维克里-克拉克-格罗夫斯（VCG）机制是机制设计中最引人注目的构造之一，但互补品的存在可能导致非核心结果，甚至出现零收入的情况。本文表明，即使所有竞标者对商品均具有替代偏好，分配上的联合可行性约束也为VCG机制中的不良结果提供了第二条路径。随后，我们发展了一套专门针对频谱拍卖分配阶段互补性的理论。分配阶段通常保证每个获胜者获得连续频谱——这被证明是一种尤为严重的联合可行性约束。我们提出了竞标者互补性的定义，并将其进一步分为直接互补性和间接互补性。当对手在竞标者偏好分配的不同部分出价时，便形成了直接竞标者互补性。然而，如果某项分配因连续性限制而被拒绝，则称为间接互补性。因此，非核心结果及其伴随的所有异常现象，在VCG分配阶段是可以预期的。接着，我们考察了一个近期引人注目的频谱拍卖——联邦通信委员会的广播激励拍卖，并首次记录了实地中的零收入结果。在至少有三名竞标者的207场分配阶段拍卖中，17.9%产生了相对于出价的非核心结果，其中3场产生了零收入。在重新调整竞标者价值后，我们发现大多数分配阶段拍卖存在可利用的竞标者互补性潜力，且绝大多数竞标者互补性——无论是潜在的还是已实现的——都是间接的。

abstract: We study the identification and estimation of large network games in which individuals choose continuous actions while holding private information about their links and payoffs. Extending the framework of Galeotti et al., we build a tractable empirical model of such network games and show that the parameters in individual payoffs are identified under large-market asymptotics in which the number of individuals increases to infinity on a single large network. We then propose a semiparametric two-step M-estimator for these individual payoffs and demonstrate its good finite-sample performance in simulations.
abstract_zh: 我们研究大型网络博弈的识别与估计问题，其中个体在持有关于其链接和收益的私人信息时选择连续行动。通过扩展Galeotti等人的框架，我们构建了此类网络博弈的一个易于处理的实证模型，并证明在大型市场渐近性下，即个体数量在单一大型网络上趋于无穷时，个体收益中的参数是可识别的。随后，我们提出了一种半参数两步M估计量来估计这些个体收益，并通过模拟展示了其在有限样本中的良好表现。

title: Competition in persuasion in the attention economy

abstract: Gentzkow and Kamenica (2016) show that competition among senders benefits receivers if and only if the information environment is Blackwell-connected. This paper shows that introducing receivers’ limited attention and heterogeneous beliefs can overturn this result. Even in a Blackwell-connected information environment, information revelation may be lower under duopoly than under monopoly. Indeed, limited attention may incentivize receivers to sort into the audiences of like-minded senders. In turn, this adverse sorting can make it optimal for senders to reveal less information.
abstract_zh: Gentzkow和Kamenica（2016）的研究表明，当且仅当信息环境是Blackwell连通的时，发送者之间的竞争对接收者有利。本文证明，引入接收者的有限注意力和异质性信念可以颠覆这一结论。即使在Blackwell连通的信息环境中，双头垄断下的信息揭示程度也可能低于垄断情形。实际上，有限注意力可能激励接收者选择加入与自己观点相似的发送者受众群体。反过来，这种不利的分群可能使发送者最优选择揭示更少的信息。

official: 官方在线 2026-01-18 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study the sustainability of international trading rules in a multipolar world. A rules-based equilibrium is shaped by three forces. A static temptation to exploit market power undermines cooperation, while two dynamic forces support it: the efficiency gains from rules and the cost of reestablishing the regime once a country becomes hegemonic. When multipolarity is short-lived and involves few co-leaders, a strong enough prospect of future hegemony ensures rules cooperation. However, in a more fragmented world, the sustainability of rules is more likely if shared leadership is expected to persist, to ensure long-lasting efficiency gains.
abstract_zh: 我们研究多极世界中国际贸易规则的可持续性。基于规则的均衡由三种力量塑造。静态的利用市场支配地位的诱惑会破坏合作，而两种动态力量则支持合作：规则带来的效率收益，以及一旦国家成为霸权后重建体制的成本。当多极化持续时间较短且涉及少数共同领导者时，足够强的未来霸权前景能够确保规则合作。然而，在一个更加碎片化的世界中，如果预期共享领导地位将持续存在，以确保长期效率收益，则规则的可持续性更有可能实现。

abstract: We estimate the effects of welfare program participation on the labor supply of those who are on the margin of participation. We develop a local IV method that can semiparametrically estimate the shape of the marginal labor supply response curve as participation grows and declines. In an application to the historical AFDC program and using an instrument for program participation costs, we estimate a quadratic curve, rising and then falling as participation rates rise The average work disincentive is modest in size but there are some margins where effects are sizable and some where it is effectively zero.
abstract_zh: 我们估算了福利计划参与对处于参与边缘人群劳动供给的影响。我们开发了一种局部工具变量方法，能够半参数地估计随着参与率上升和下降时边际劳动供给响应曲线的形状。在应用于历史上的AFDC计划并使用一个针对参与成本的工具变量时，我们估计出一条二次曲线，该曲线随参与率上升先增后减。平均工作抑制效应规模适中，但在某些边际上效应显著，而在另一些边际上则几乎为零。

abstract: We study a platform's incentives to remove IP-infringing products and the effects of holding the platform liable for such infringements on innovation and welfare. We first show that platform liability can lead to either higher or lower commission rates, depending on how screening affects transaction volume. We then show that liability may spur or hinder innovation, depending on the intensity of cross-group network externalities, which determines participation elasticities on each side. If platform liability lowers innovation, all market participants—the platform, innovators, imitators, and buyers—are worse off. We also provide a sufficient condition for platform liability to raise welfare.
abstract_zh: 我们研究平台移除知识产权侵权产品的激励，以及平台对此类侵权承担责任对创新和福利的影响。我们首先表明，平台责任可能导致佣金率上升或下降，这取决于筛选如何影响交易量。接着，我们证明责任可能促进或阻碍创新，这取决于跨群体网络外部性的强度，该强度决定了各方的参与弹性。如果平台责任降低了创新，所有市场参与者——平台、创新者、模仿者和买家——都将受损。我们还提供了平台责任提升福利的一个充分条件。

title: Impact of “localized” rural workforce on food production: based on a comprehensive analysis of three major markets
title_zh: 本地化”农村劳动力对粮食生产的影响：基于三大市场的综合分析
title_primary: 本地化”农村劳动力对粮食生产的影响：基于三大市场的综合分析
title_secondary: Impact of “localized” rural workforce on food production: based on a comprehensive analysis of three major markets
authors: Dingde Xu, Yichao Li
official: 官方在线 2025-09-05 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The return of rural labour has led to a rise in the ‘localization’ of work, which in turn has triggered changes in the structure of household labour. In the context of food security, the impact of this change on food production deserves attention. Analyzes the impact of ‘localized’ and ‘non-localized’ rural labour on food production using data from the 2020 China Rural Revitalization Survey (CRRS). The results show that: (1) ‘localized’ labour is more likely to promote food production than ‘non- localized’ labour. (2) ‘localized’ and ‘non-localized’ workers can inhibit food production by increasing the time share of labour inputs. (3) ‘localized’ and ‘non-localized’ workers can promote food production by increasing the level of survival security of workers. (4) Market heterogeneity and food type heterogeneity have differentiated effects on the impact of ‘localization’ on food production. Based on this, the study suggests that we should promote the industrialization and urbanization of prefectures, maximize the non-farm income of part-time labourers and the ‘trinity’ of the local land transfer market, agricultural socialized service market, and employment market.
abstract_zh: 农村劳动力回流导致工作“本地化”程度上升，进而引发家庭劳动力结构变化。在粮食安全背景下，这一变化对粮食生产的影响值得关注。利用2020年中国乡村振兴调查（CRRS）数据，分析农村劳动力“本地化”与“非本地化”对粮食生产的影响。结果表明：（1）“本地化”劳动力比“非本地化”劳动力更可能促进粮食生产。（2）“本地化”与“非本地化”劳动力均可能通过增加劳动投入时间份额抑制粮食生产。（3）“本地化”与“非本地化”劳动力均可能通过提高劳动者生存保障水平促进粮食生产。（4）市场异质性与粮食类型异质性对“本地化”影响粮食生产具有差异化效应。据此，研究建议应推进地级市工业化与城镇化，最大化兼业劳动力非农收入与本地土地流转市场、农业社会化服务市场、就业市场的“三位一体”协同发展。

abstract: We study how the rapid adoption of FinTech payment technology, Zelle, affects crime in the United States. We collect a novel dataset of Zelle’s banking partners using an internet archive tool-the Wayback Machine. Our baseline OLS model shows a higher Zelle penetration is associated with a lower robbery rate and motor vehicle theft rate at the county level. To address the reverse causality issue, we exploit the fact that Zelle was launched by the seven largest U.S. banks in 2017. The difference-in-difference analysis shows that counties with large exposure to the seven largest U.S. banks before 2017 experienced a large decline in the robbery rate and motor vehicle theft rate. The negative effect on the robbery rate was more pronounced in counties with lower education levels and fewer law employees. Our findings shed light on the evolution of the social impact of FinTech adoption.
